exercises.title: Depreciation increases
exercises.event: Depreciation (avskrivningar) increases by 100. Walk the change through all three statements.
assumptions: The company is profitable, so lower pre-tax profit means lower tax.
Tax is paid in cash in the same period.
Book depreciation equals tax depreciation, so all of it is tax deductible.

notes.da: An expense in the income statement. No cash leaves the company.
notes.ppe: Depreciation lowers the book value of the machines.

exercises.keyPoint: Profit falls but cash rises. Depreciation is not a cash cost, yet it lowers taxable profit. The lower tax bill, {abs:tax}, is the only cash effect.
